10001 selected invoices use the existing nullable monthRef plus YYYY-MM legacy month representation to preserve the unique client/monthRef constraint. Payments/logs add two out-of-period sentinels each.
Each saved record contains 24 pool summaries, literal Unicode/HTML-like text, zero/null and a review-version sentinel. Source data are compared in full.
